findings.description: The Lambda environment contains an AWS access key ID and secret access key in plaintext. Environment variables can be read by principals with Lambda configuration access and may be exposed through deployment state or logs, enabling misuse of the embedded credentials.

The function uses nodejs12.x, an end-of-life runtime that no longer receives security updates. Known runtime and dependency vulnerabilities may remain exploitable in the deployed execution environment.
